name: Red vs Blue Battle
description: Adaptive battle: the red team enters from the internet toward the file server. After each blue defense, the red team searches for an alternate path and tries again, for up to 5 rounds, until no path remains.

attack_steps.description: Red team probes the firewall from the internet
Red team reaches the DMZ web server
Red team pivots into the application server
Red team attempts to reach the file server

invariant: No path from the internet to the file server remains after adaptation rounds
